name: Gakuen Counselor
source:
Main character lives with his father, mother-in-law and sister. One day his father is asked to become a masked counselor at a prestigious school with his children allowed to study there in exchange. However, father has urgent business overseas leaving protagonist to play the role of masked counselor of all these cute school girls including his sister.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角和父親、繼母以及妹妹一起生活。一天，父親被邀請到一所名門學校擔任蒙面輔導員，作為交換，孩子們可以在那裡學習。

然而，父親因海外的緊急事務離開了，只留下主角代替他，擔任包括妹妹在內的所有可愛女學生的蒙面輔導員。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]］
